responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_session/src/config/cfg.rs: Defines the compiler’s internal representation of active `cfg` settings and `--check-cfg` expectations, builds the session’s default builtin configuration from target and option state, records well-known cfg names and values for validation, and reports uses of builtin cfgs that are forbidden on the command line because they must be driven by dedicated compiler options. compiler/rustc_session/src/config/native_libs.rs: Parses `-l` command-line options into `NativeLib` records by splitting each option into its syntactic parts, mapping library kinds, applying and validating linking modifiers, enforcing unstable-feature gating for nightly-only forms, and emitting early fatal diagnostics for malformed or incompatible native library specifications. compiler/rustc_session/src/config/native_libs/tests.rs: Provides unit tests for the native library `-l` option parser’s string-splitting helper, verifying that raw flag values are decomposed into kind, modifiers, library name, and rename parts for the accepted command-line syntactic forms. compiler/rustc_session/src/config/sigpipe.rs: Defines the numeric constants used by session configuration to represent the compiler’s supported `-Z on-broken-pipe` behaviors, including the default, inherited, ignore, and default-signal handling modes that must stay synchronized with the standard library’s Unix runtime handling.
